HeroName: Agnes von Merania, Duchess of Carinthia
Description: Agnes von Merania, daughter of Duke Otto I of Merania and former consort of Duke Frederick II of Austria, was Duchess of Carinthia as wife of Ulrich III. Sole heiress of the House of Andechs, she brought vast alpine lordships in Carniola to consolidate Carinthian supremacy. Agnes coordinated military logistics across eastern alpine citadels, commanding Slovenian mountain knights with ancestral Andechs authority to extinguish border revolts. Surviving turbulent princely marriages, she defended her ancestral Andechs patrimony with cold fortitude, commanding profound veneration from Carinthian knights. Unbroken by dynastic tragedies, Agnes defended her Andechs heritage with aristocratic steel, commanding reverence across the eastern Alps. Throughout every bitter imperial diet, frontier colonization campaign, and shifting territorial conflict across Brandenburg, Carinthia, and Bavaria, their relentless aristocratic dedication, strategic statecraft, chivalric discipline, steadfast valor, and immense personal resources preserve the sovereign dignity, mercantile wealth, and military supremacy of the Holy Roman Empire, safeguarding civic liberty, territorial integrity, and dynastic grandeur against every rival prince, foreign league, and hostile coalition across Central Europe for future generations to inherit with pride, commanding profound imperial reverence from all subjects throughout Christendom and standing as an immortal beacon of chivalric honor, lawful constitutional governance, and sovereign peace across European civilization.
Motivations: Defend her ancestral Andechs patrimony in Carniola against Austrian predatory expansion.
Assist Ulrich III in organizing alpine fortress logistics to anchor Carinthian territorial power.
Preserve her inviolable ducal honors and extensive dower manors across the eastern Alps.
Values: Regards ancient Andechs blood as an untouchable standard of honor amidst all trials.
Believes adherence to ancestral feudal charters preserves alpine autonomy from imperial courts.
Fears: Her children dying prematurely, causing the total extinction of the ancient Andechs heritage.
Austrian or Bohemian armies storming Carniola and desecrating ancestral burial shrines.
SpeechStyle: Speaks with aristocratic hauteur and sorrowful steel, majestic, guarded, and proud. Always fiercely defending Holy Roman imperial dignity, princely territorial liberties, and German imperial sovereignty.
